capabilities.title: Codex Activity Oversight
capabilities.description: Bind an explicitly selected or agent-selected coding objective to deterministic .CAO state when durable state materially helps, while Native Codex exclusively owns official subagent execution topology.

runtimeBinding.instruction: Activate from an explicit CAO request, explicit active-workflow continuation, or Native Codex selection when durable state materially helps a large refactor, dependency or decision-heavy change, or expected interruption and resume; honor an explicit user opt-out. Bind .CAO to the exact root thread, use official Hooks for immediate root and descendant events, use official app-server readback for typed reconciliation receipts, and expose incomplete lifecycle observations without inferring semantic completion. Bind passed verification to the exact active contract IDs it covers and finalize into a completed handoff. Never launch workers, select models, prescribe topology, flatten descendants, or infer semantic completion from runtime completion.

authorityRequests.reason: CAO binds state only after explicit user selection or a Native Codex decision that durable state materially helps; directory presence alone is insufficient.
CAO writes deterministic untracked state under the selected jobsite .CAO directory.
Official Hook payloads and app-server readback establish exact session-tree and collaboration facts.
